import sys,json,base64,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'deps')
import zstandard as zstd
HDR='type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,result,service,attempt,payload\n'
row='icmp,a,é,1,put,h,1,0/i1,2001:db8::1,2001:db8::1,echo,,,\n'
data=(HDR+row).encode();# split mid é (after 'a,')
print(data[:12],data[12:16])
parts=[data[:12],data[12:16],data[16:]]
c=zstd.ZstdCompressor();frames=b''.join(c.compress(p) for p in parts)
job={'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':[{'id':'h','prefix':'2001:db8::/64','start':0,'end':10,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}],'services':[],'queries':[5],'captures':[{'encoding':'zstd','chunks':[base64.b64encode(frames).decode()]}],'requests':[],'offers':[],'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','submission/campaign.py'],input=json.dumps(job).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print(p.stdout[:300])
EOF
